description: This file defines models, utility functions, and classes related to JavaScript functions within the Thingsboard project, including function compilation, module loading, and code/documentation generation.

classes.name: CompiledTbFunction
classes.description: Encapsulates a compiled JavaScript function with optional modules, allowing execution with arguments and module injection.

methods.name: isNotEmptyTbFunction
methods.description: Checks if a TbFunction (string or object) is non-empty.

methods.name: compileTbFunction
methods.description: Compiles a TbFunction (string or object) into a JavaScript function, loading required modules.

methods.name: loadModulesCompleter
methods.description: Loads module completions for code editor autocompletion based on provided module links.

methods.name: loadModuleMarkdownDescription
methods.description: Generates markdown documentation for a module, including its members.

methods.name: loadModuleMarkdownSourceCode
methods.description: Loads source code of a module and formats it as markdown.

methods.name: loadModuleCompletion
methods.description: Loads completion info for a module, including functions and constants.

methods.name: getFunctionArguments
methods.description: Extracts argument names from a JavaScript function.
